limitations: Common grid resolution is 0.1 degree (~10 km); does not create artificial sub-grid Doppler-radar resolution.
action_needed: Preserve common grid geometry across future multi-year archive expansion.

synopsis_requirement: Meteorological Baseline Nowcasting (Persistence and Optical Flow)
evidence: Lagged Persistence and Semi-Lagrangian Optical Flow evaluated across 5 horizons (+30m to +360m). Persistence CSI: 0.3928 (+30m) down to 0.0082 (+360m); Optical flow CSI: 0.3945 (+30m) down to 0.0145 (+360m).
limitations: Kinematic advection cannot simulate convective initiation or cloud dissipation mechanisms over multi-hour horizons.
action_needed: Documented in baseline benchmark registries and publication figures.

synopsis_requirement: Deep Spatiotemporal Weather Nowcasting (+30m to +180m Horizons)
evidence: Multi-Year 2D ConvLSTM trained on combined 2024 and 2025 data (528 training steps). Held-out test CSI: 0.4225 (+30m) 0.3045 (+60m) 0.1415 (+120m) 0.0585 (+180m). Consistently outperforms single-year pilot and baselines.
actual_data_period: Train: 2024 full week + 2025 July 1-4; Val: July 5; Test: July 6-7 2025
limitations: Observational skill attenuates rapidly past 2-3 hours due to physical cell dissipation.
action_needed: Apply Platt scaling or isotonic regression to calibrate probabilistic outputs.

evidence: Empirically evaluated as a separately labelled experiment. CSI at +360m drops to 0.0210 (ConvLSTM) 0.0145 (OF) 0.0082 (Persistence). Proves physical limit of observational nowcasting.
limitations: Extrapolation beyond 2-3 hours cannot resolve moist convective thermodynamic growth and strictly requires Numerical Weather Prediction (WRF/NWP).
action_needed: Couple satellite nowcasting with 3 km WRF/NCMRWF dynamical weather forecast grids.

synopsis_requirement: Topographic Feature Engineering from Authoritative NASA SRTM DEM
evidence: 8 USGS SRTM 30m DEM tiles merged and clipped to Survey of India Meghalaya boundary polygon. Computed 90m slope aspect (sin/cos) and surface curvature rasters.
limitations: Static terrain does not account for transient vegetation changes soil moisture or anthropogenic slope cutting.
action_needed: Integrate Sentinel-2 NDVI and SMAP soil moisture in future iterations.
